hero.title: The Collective
hero.intro: Immersive People is not an agency with a headcount. It is a living network of curators, artists, storytellers, researchers and production partners, organised around one idea: the world's stories deserve to be experienced, not just told.

vision.title: Cultural memory, made experiential
vision.text: We imagine a world where heritage, science, nature and human stories are not locked in archives or flattened onto screens, but staged as encounters. Experiences you stand inside, share with strangers, and carry with you. Our vision is a global circuit of venues, museums and public spaces where immersive culture travels as naturally as touring exhibitions once did.

mission.title: Create once, resonate everywhere
mission.text: Our mission is to create and license story-driven immersive productions of lasting cultural value, and to make them travel. We develop each production once, with depth and craft, then adapt it across venues, markets and formats through a single licence. This is how a story born in Anatolia reaches a museum in Europe, and how a venue anywhere gains a library of 36 productions across eight thematic worlds.

principles.title: Four principles hold the collective together

items.title: Curated Depth
items.text: Every production begins with genuine subject expertise. Historians, scientists, musicians and craftspeople shape the work before any technology enters the room.

items.title: Built to Travel
items.text: Productions are designed venue-agnostic from day one, so the same story can live in a museum hall, a public installation or a branded space.

items.title: Shared Authorship
items.text: The collective model means contributors remain visible in the work they shape. Credit, rights and returns are structured, not implied.

items.title: Craft Across Senses
items.text: Space, message, sound and visuals are composed together. An experience is finished only when it is felt, not merely seen.

join.title: Join the Collective
join.text: Bring a subject area, a creative vision or a strategic capability. We run a continuous open call for curators, artists, technologists and partners who want their work to travel.
